dialogue.realtalk: You've come to the right person, %1$s. Ask away — I give excellent answers.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.good: Splendidly, of course. The bread rose, the fence held, and the week went precisely as I intended.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.rough: A difficult stretch. Not a defeat — a delay. Though I'll admit, %1$s, your asking helps the schedule.
dialogue.realtalk.day.good: Exactly as planned. Cold well water, short line at the smith, sun on time. The day knows better than to cross me.
dialogue.realtalk.day.rough: The day is misbehaving. It will come around by supper. They always do when I'm involved.
dialogue.realtalk.work.like: Naturally. I'm the best at it for three villages in any direction, and that is a simple statement of fact.
dialogue.realtalk.work.hate: Between us — the work is beneath me. I do it flawlessly anyway. Standards are standards.
dialogue.realtalk.life.first: A fine story, saved for the right audience. It begins with a stubborn child who was right about nearly everything.
dialogue.realtalk.dreams.first: I don't dream, %1$s — I plan. And the plan is a house on the hill everyone said couldn't be built. Watch me.
dialogue.realtalk.fears.first: You'll keep this quiet. I fear being ordinary. Waking up one morning as just another face at the well.
dialogue.realtalk.feelings.first: I have excellent taste, %1$s, and I've decided you're worth keeping around. Take that as the honor it is.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.personal: That answer is reserved for my inner circle. Small circle. Excellent view. Earn your seat.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.intimate: Even I don't hand that answer to just anyone, %1$s. Prove yourself first. I suspect you will.
dialogue.realtalk.gossip.none: Nothing worth my attention this week. When something happens, I'll know it first. I always do.
dialogue.chat: Conversation with me? Wise choice. People pay for this in some villages, %1$s.
